name: arclight-medicare-audit-navigator
description: A de-identified Medicare audit-readiness navigator with notice triage, wound-care evidence mapping, corrective-action planning, appeal-stage preparation, financial scenario comparisons, and skin-substitute literature assessment.

interface.longDescription: Helps small practices and revenue cycle teams prepare for Medicare audits, prepayment denials, and fee-for-service appeals using de-identified or synthetic information. It triages notices, maps wound-care evidence, separates internal corrective-action analysis from reviewer-facing work, compares denial rationales, and plans appeal stages. It also compares appeal costs using explicit financial assumptions and assesses skin-substitute literature, real-world evidence, and related-product arguments. Financial scenarios do not estimate actual win probabilities. Includes selected AmchoPlast references, not an exhaustive evidence library or treatment selector. It has no connection or data transmission to Arclight, does not review identifiable records or submit appeals, and retains provider, compliance, and legal review.
defaultPrompt: Help our small wound-care practice prepare for a Medicare audit without uploading patient records.
Compare hypothetical audit repayment and appeal costs, showing break-even odds without estimating my actual chances.
Assess public skin-substitute studies for an experimental or investigational denial and identify evidence gaps.
